```{ojs}
//| title: "Cuadrantes de liquidez y endeudamiento por año"
{
  const filas = porAnio.flatMap(p => {
    const rows = base.filter(d => d.anio === p.anio && d.cuad)
    return CUADS.map(c => { const n = rows.filter(d => d.cuad === c.k).length
      return {anio: p.anio, cuad: c.k, nombre: c.nombre, n, pct: rows.length ? n / rows.length : 0} })
  })
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: anchoMedio, height: 340, marginLeft: 44, style: estilo,
    x: {type: "band", label: null, tickFormat: d => anchoMedio < 480 ? "’" + String(d).slice(2) : String(d), padding: 0.18},
    y: {label: null, percent: true, tickFormat: d => d + "%", grid: true, ticks: 5},
    color: {domain: CUADS.map(c => c.k), range: CUADS.map(c => c.color)},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(filas, Plot.stackY({order: [1, 2, 3, 4]}, {x: "anio", y: "pct", fill: "cuad", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 1.5,
        fillOpacity: d => (anio === "*" || d.anio === anio) ? 1 : 0.5,
        channels: {Cuadrante: "nombre", Empresas: d => fEnt(d.n), Participación: d => fPct(d.pct)},
        tip: {format: {x: true, y: false, fill: false, Cuadrante: true, Empresas: true, Participación: true}, fontSize: 12}})),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#C8CDD8"})
    ]
  })
  return conPNG(html`${leyenda(CUADS.map(c => ({...c, rango: null})))}${plot}`, "cuadrantes_por_anio")
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Probabilidad de estar en Distress al año siguiente, por cuadrante"
{
  const ultimo = anio === anioMax
  const pe = porEmpresa(base)
  const filas = CUADS.map(c => {
    let n = 0, k = 0, hoyN = 0, hoyD = 0
    const ra = []
    for (const anios of pe.values()) for (const [a, d] of anios) {
      if (d.cuad !== c.k || (anio !== "*" && !ultimo && a !== anio)) continue
      if (d.zona) { hoyN++; if (d.zona === "D") hoyD++ }
      if (Number.isFinite(d.ra)) ra.push(d.ra)
      const s = anios.get(a + 1)
      if (s && s.zona) { n++; if (s.zona === "D") k++ }
    }
    const [lo, hi] = wilson(k, n)
    return {...c, n, k, p: n ? k / n : NaN, lo, hi, hoy: hoyN ? hoyD / hoyN : NaN, filas: hoyN, ra: d3.median(ra)}
  })
  const totFilas = d3.sum(filas, d => d.filas)
  const conDatos = filas.filter(d => d.n > 0)
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: anchoMedio, height: 230, marginLeft: 175, marginRight: 70, style: estilo,
    x: {label: null, tickFormat: fPct0, grid: true, ticks: 5, domain: [0, Math.max(0.2, d3.max(conDatos, d => d.hi) ?? 0.2)]},
    y: {label: null, domain: CUADS.map(c => c.nombre), tickSize: 0},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(conDatos, {y: "nombre", x: "p", fill: "color", insetTop: 8, insetBottom: 8}),
      Plot.ruleY(conDatos, {y: "nombre", x1: "lo", x2: "hi", stroke: "#14213D", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      Plot.tickX(conDatos, {y: "nombre", x: "lo", stroke: "#14213D", insetTop: 12, insetBottom: 12}),
      Plot.tickX(conDatos, {y: "nombre", x: "hi", stroke: "#14213D", insetTop: 12, insetBottom: 12}),
      Plot.text(conDatos, {y: "nombre", x: "hi", text: d => fPct(d.p), dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fontWeight: 700, fill: "#14213D"}),
      Plot.tip(conDatos, Plot.pointerY({y: "nombre", x: "p", fontSize: 12,
        title: d => `${d.nombre}: ${d.detalle}\nProbabilidad: ${fPct(d.p)}\nIC 95%: ${fPct(d.lo)} a ${fPct(d.hi)}\n${fEnt(d.n)} observaciones con año siguiente`}))
    ]
  })
  return conPNG(html`<div class="subtitulo">Barra = probabilidad observada; línea = intervalo de confianza del 95% (Wilson).
    ${anio === "*" ? "Todos los años." : ultimo ? "" : `Empresas en ${anio}, Distress medido en ${anio + 1}.`}</div>
    ${ultimo ? html`<p class="aviso">${anioMax} es el último corte y aún no tiene año siguiente: se muestran todos los años (2016–2024 → 2017–2025).</p>` : ""}${plot}
    <table class="tabla-simple">
      <tr><th>Cuadrante</th><th>% del total</th><th>% en Distress hoy</th><th>ROA mediano</th></tr>
      ${filas.map(d => html`<tr><td><i class="punto" style="background:${d.color}"></i>${d.nombre}</td>
        <td>${fPct(d.filas / totFilas)}</td><td>${fPct(d.hoy)}</td><td>${Number.isFinite(d.ra) ? fPct(d.ra) : "–"}</td></tr>`)}
    </table>`, "riesgo_por_cuadrante")
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Cada empresa en el mapa de liquidez y deuda"
{
  const pts = base.filter(d => d.anio === foco && Number.isFinite(d.cr) && Number.isFinite(d.ti) && d.zona)
    .map(d => ({...d, x: Math.min(50, Math.max(0.05, d.cr)), y: Math.min(1.5, Math.max(0, d.ti))}))
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: anchoMedio, height: 420, marginLeft: 48, marginRight: 16, marginBottom: 40, style: estilo,
    x: {type: "log", label: "Razón corriente (escala logarítmica) →", domain: [0.05, 50], ticks: [0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50], tickFormat: d => loc.format(",")(d)},
    y: {label: "↑ Endeudamiento total", domain: [0, 1.5], tickFormat: fPct0, grid: true},
    color: {domain: ZONAS.map(z => z.k), range: ZONAS.map(z => z.color)},
    marks: [
      Plot.rect([{x1: 0.05, x2: 1, y1: 0.7, y2: 1.5}], {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "#B42318", fillOpacity: 0.06}),
      Plot.dot(pts, {x: "x", y: "y", fill: "zona", r: 1.8, fillOpacity: 0.55}),
      Plot.ruleX([1], {stroke: "#14213D", strokeDasharray: "4 3"}),
      Plot.ruleY([0.7], {stroke: "#14213D", strokeDasharray: "4 3"}),
      Plot.text([{x: 0.06, y: 1.45, t: "Crítico"}, {x: 0.06, y: 0.05, t: "Tensión de liquidez"},
                 {x: 45, y: 1.45, t: "Apalancada con liquidez"}, {x: 45, y: 0.05, t: "Holgada"}],
        {x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", textAnchor: d => d.x < 1 ? "start" : "end", fontWeight: 700, fill: "#14213D", fontSize: 11, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 4, paintOrder: "stroke"}),
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({x: "x", y: "y", fontSize: 12, maxRadius: 12,
        title: d => `${nomEmpresa.get(d.nit) ?? d.nit}\n${nomSector.get(d.sec) ?? d.sec} · ${nomDepto(d.dep)}\nRazón corriente: ${fDec(d.cr)} · Endeudamiento: ${fPct(d.ti)}\nZ': ${fDec(d.z)} (${nomZona.get(d.zona)})`}))
    ]
  })
  return conPNG(html`${leyenda(ZONAS)}<div class="subtitulo">${fEnt(pts.length)} empresas en ${foco}. Cada punto es una empresa, coloreada por su zona del Z'.
    Pase el mouse para ver cuál es. Valores extremos recortados a los bordes.</div>${plot}`, "liquidez_vs_deuda")
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "¿Qué significa endeudarse? Distress y rentabilidad por decil de endeudamiento"
{
  const filas = d3.range(1, 11).map(k => {
    const rows = sel.filter(d => d.dec === k)
    const z = rows.filter(d => d.zona)
    return {dec: k, n: rows.length, ti: d3.median(rows, d => d.ti),
      dist: z.length ? z.filter(d => d.zona === "D").length / z.length : NaN,
      ra: d3.median(rows, d => d.ra), om: d3.median(rows, d => d.om)}
  }).filter(d => d.n > 0)
  const p1 = Plot.plot({
    width: anchoMedio, height: 210, marginLeft: 44, style: estilo,
    x: {type: "band", label: "Decil de endeudamiento (1 = menos endeudadas) →", tickFormat: d => `D${d}`},
    y: {label: "% en Distress", percent: true, tickFormat: d => d + "%", grid: true, ticks: 4},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(filas, {x: "dec", y: "dist", fill: "#D03B3B", insetLeft: 3, insetRight: 3,
        channels: {"Endeudamiento mediano": d => fPct(d.ti), Empresas: d => fEnt(d.n)},
        tip: {format: {x: d => `Decil ${d}`, y: d => fPct(d / 100)}, fontSize: 12}}),
      Plot.text(filas, {x: "dec", y: "dist", text: d => fPct0(d.dist), dy: -6, lineAnchor: "bottom", fontSize: 10.5, fill: "#4A5468"}),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#C8CDD8"})
    ]
  })
  const largo = filas.flatMap(d => [{dec: d.dec, serie: "ROA", v: d.ra}, {dec: d.dec, serie: "Margen operacional", v: d.om}])
  const p2 = Plot.plot({
    width: anchoMedio, height: 200, marginLeft: 44, marginRight: 150, style: estilo,
    x: {label: null, tickFormat: d => `D${d}`, ticks: 10, domain: [1, 10]},
    y: {label: "Mediana", grid: true, tickFormat: d => loc.format(".0%")(d), ticks: 4},
    color: {domain: ["ROA", "Margen operacional"], range: ["#2C5697", "#E8703A"]},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#C8CDD8"}),
      Plot.lineY(largo, {x: "dec", y: "v", stroke: "serie", strokeWidth: 2.5, curve: "monotone-x"}),
      Plot.dot(largo, {x: "dec", y: "v", fill: "serie", r: 3}),
      Plot.text(largo.filter(d => d.dec === 10), {x: "dec", y: "v", text: d => `${d.serie} ${fPct(d.v)}`, dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fill: "serie", fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 11}),
      Plot.tip(largo, Plot.pointer({x: "dec", y: "v", title: d => `Decil ${d.dec}\n${d.serie}: ${fPct(d.v)}`, fontSize: 12}))
    ]
  })
  return conPNG(html`<div class="subtitulo">Deciles calculados dentro de cada año sobre todas las empresas (script 03).
    A más deuda, más empresas en Distress y menor rentabilidad. ${textoFiltro}.</div>${p1}${p2}`, "deciles_endeudamiento")
}
```
